From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: sam.hart@acme.com
Date: Tue, 26 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Horizon: week 31 forecast handback + attestation checklist

Team / CloudWave,

Timebox: quick action — need forecast entries + attestation by EOD Thursday (7/28). This is the handback from our revenue ops intake: please treat as final ask for Week 31 submission.

High level:
- What we need: updated ARR and commit-stage for each account in the attached Week31_Forecast_Template.xlsx. Highlight any moves (Up / Down / At-risk).
- Evidence: for any amount > $50k or stage move to Commit, upload the minimal evidence packet to the Drive folder linked below and list the filename in the workbook. The Evidence_Packet_Req.pdf outlines required docs.
- Attestation: add a one-line attestation in column H of the template: "I attest that this entry reflects the latest customer confirmation (name & date)".

Call: I scheduled a 30-minute quick-sync on Thu 7/28 10:00–10:30 PT to review high-risk accounts and finalize rollups. Calendar invite attached (Horizon_Agenda_20280728.ics). If you cannot make it, please add notes to the workbook and ping me.

Priority ask by role:
- Ben: update the mid-market roster (rows 40–78) and flag any EU-regional routing needs.
- Marissa: validate enterprise deal evidence for the three top-line accounts (Acme, CloudWave, StellarIo).
- Irene: sweep for duplicate bookings and confirm model-level SKU/usage assumptions.

External note to CloudWave / Sam: we need a brief confirmation on the two pipeline opportunities tagged as "POC->Commit". If you can reply with the customer-signed confirmation or a scheduled procurement call, that will suffice for our attestation.

Links & attachments: Drive folder (see related_links), template and evidence guide attached.

Thanks — keep it tight and explicit in the workbook so RevOps can ingest without follow-ups.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick replies. Short answers and next steps: 

1) Evidence: a PO or customer confirmation email is acceptable for attestation; SOW only required for contracts that include implementation services. CloudWave — please send the confirmation to procurement@redwood.com and drop the filename in the template.

2) Billing cutover: target effective date is 2028-08-01 for any commits approved in this submission. Finance will process next-run invoices if we receive confirmations by Thu noon.

Agenda for Thu 10:00–10:30 PT (call):
- 10:00–10:05: Rapid roll call and top-line numbers (Vanessa)
- 10:05–10:15: Review 4 high-risk accounts (Ben / Marissa)
- 10:15–10:25: Evidence status and final attestation (Irene / CloudWave)
- 10:25–10:30: Close & post-submission responsibilities (Vanessa)

If you cannot attend, please:
- add row-level notes in the workbook (column I) with a short rationale, and
- include a named verifier that can attest on your behalf.

I've attached the final agenda and re-shared the Drive folder (link above). HubSpot deal RDW-ACME-2028-Q3 has been tagged for the submission so RevOps will correlate automatically.

See you on the call — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Vanessa
